content: Pilatoman Jesusta chrächipäcungan

Chaypitam nä pacha warayämuptinga sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunawan, marcachru alinninpag ricasha chacha runacunaga, jinaman Moisés isquirbinganpita yachrachigcunaga, marcachru chay lapan mandagcunaga, rimanacurcurmi Jesusta aywachicurcan maquin watashata chay nación mandag Pilatoman.
Chrarärichiptinmi Pilatoga Jesusta tapurun: “¿Gam razonpachu cayanqui cay Israel runacunapa reynin?” Niptin Jesusga “Au, gam ningaynuymi cayä” nirunmi.
Nätan sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunaga aliscam ima-aygapitas Jesusta juchachapäcura chay Pilatopa naupanchru.
Chaynuy nipäcuptin yapaytan Pilatoga tapurun Jesusta cay nir: “Chaynuy ima-aygapitas juchacharcayäshuptiqui ¿manachu imatasi ninqui?”
Nätan chaynuy niyaptinsi Jesusga upälalam cacura. Chaura mana imatasi rimacuptinga Pilatoga mayacasham ricacarura.
Jesusta yangapita juchacharcur “Wanuchun” nipäcungan
Chaura chay fiesta wichan Pilatoga cachrarichrag cara carcelpita juc runatam, runacuna manacunganta.
Chauraga Barrabás jutiyog runam, waquin purig-mayincunawan carcelchru cara. Paycunaga carcelman jitayusha capäcura Roma nacionpa munayninpita yargoyta munar, runacunata wanuchipäcunganpitam.
Chaura runacunaga Pilatoman aywarcurmi manacarärin: “Imaysi rurachrangaynuynar carcelpita jucta cachrarï” nir.
Niräriptinmi Pilatoga nirun: “¿Gamcuna munarcayanqui reyniqui Jesusta cachrarinätachu?”
Chaynuy nira Pilatoga sacerdöticunapa mandagnincuna chriquicuylapita payman aywachipäcunganta musyarmi.
Chaura chay chriqui runacunaga achca runacunatam yachrachiyta galacayärin, “¡Barrabasta cachrariparcämay nishun!” nir.
Chaynuy nipäcuptin Pilatoga yapaytan tapurun cay nir: “¿Chaura ima ruranätatag munarcayanqui Israel castacuna ‘Payga reynïmi’ nipäcungayta?”
Niptin paycunaga gayachracuypanuymi gaparäcurcan: “¡Cruzchru wanuchun! ¡Cruzchru wanuchun!” nir.
Nipäcuptinmi Pilatoga nirun: “Nipäcunaypagga ¿ima juchatatag rurarayan?” Niptin paycunaga masran gaparäcurcansi: “¡Cruzchru wanuchun! ¡Cruzchru wanuchun!” nir.
Chaura Pilatoga chay runacuna manacurcangannuy rurarmi Barrabasta cachrarirun, nätan Jesustam alisca astircachirga nirura cruzman clävapäcamunanpag.
Chaura soldäducunaga Jesusta yaycarärichin Pilatopa mandacunan wayi puncumanmi, soldäducuna cacurcänanman. Jinarcurmi goturärin chaychru cag lapan soldäducunata.
Chaychrümi Jesusta jatiräripun reypa puca jacunta. Chaypitam jatiräripun umanman cashapita rurasha corönata.
Jinacarcärirga saludagtucuytam galacayärin “Cawachun Israelcunapa reynin” nir.
Jinarcurga chaglawanmi umachru wipyacurcan, togapäcurcan. Chaypitam gongorpayärir manchacugtucurcara.
Chaynuy turyaparcärirga, chay puca jacu jatipurcangantam logtiräripun. Jinarcurmi gangalanta quiquinpa jacunta jatircaripur aywachicurcan cruzman clävapäcunanpag.
Jesusta cruzman clävapäcungan
Jinarcurmi Cirene marcapita Simón runataga chracrapita aywayämuptin charirärin Jesús apayangan cruzta apananpag. Chay Simonga cara Alejandropawan Rufopa taytanmi.
Chaypitam Jesustaga chrarärichin Golgotaman. (Golgotaga cara ‘Umam tullu’ nirayag gotupa jutinmi.)
Chaychrümi ‘mirra’ ningan usuncächicug jampita vïnuwan tacushata upyachiyta munapäcura. Nätan Jesusga manam upyayta munarachu.
Chaypitam nä cruzman clävarcärir soldäducunaga chüsapäcura Jesuspa jacunta maygansi apacurcänanpag.
Chay cruzman clävapäcura pacha waranganpita nä quima üra cayaptinmi.
Nätan imapita cruzman clävapäcungansi musyacänanpag, cay nir isquirbishatam cruzpa umanman chrurapäcura: “ISRAEL RUNACUNAPA REYNIN” nishata.
Jinaman paytawan parëjum ishcay suwacunatas clävarärin, juctam derëchanman jucnintam ichogninman.
Nätan chaypa pasagcunam umanta awircur awircur Jesusta nipäcura cay nir: “Gam ‘Diospa wayinta juchrurcachir, quima junagta yapay sharcachishag’ nigchu jinarayanqui.
Mänar quiquiqui salvacuy, jinaman cruzpita mä jegarpamuy” nir.

Chaynuymi sacerdöticunapa mandagnincunas, Moisés isquirbinganpita yachrachigcunawan turyapapäcura. Jinarcurmi quiquincama cay ninacurcara: “Juccunataga salvara, nätan quiquingä manatan salvacuyta atipanchu”.

Chaypitas nipäcuram: “Mänar Israel runacunapa reynin cayarga, jinaman Diospa acrashan Cristo cayarga, mä ricapäcunapag cruzpita jegarpamuy. Chaymi ichaga razonpam canag nipäcushagga”. Nätan paywan cruzchru clävarayagcunasi ashlipapäcuram.
Jesús wanungan
Chaypitam nä chraupi junag cayaptin, pachaga shumag chacarun, jinaman chaynuy chacashala cara quima üraran.

Nä quima üra chay yanauyag cayaptinmi, Jesusga lapan calpanpa gayachracaramun cay nir: “Eloi, Eloi, ¿lama sabactani?” nir. (Chay ninan cara “Diosnilä, Diosnilä, ¿imanirtag washamayta gongarunqui?” ninanmi.)
Chaychru juc ishcay cayagcuna mayarärirga “Diospa unay willacugnin Eliastam gayacuyan” nipäcuram.

Chauraga chaychru cayagcunapitam jucga wayrala aywarcur puchgorisha vïnuman esponjata tawirun, jinarcurmi chaglapa puntanman chriquircur Jesuspa shiminman chaccharcachir shogoyächiptinmi waquin runaga cay nirärin: “Ama shogochiychu. Mä ricashun, Elías shamunagchush cruzpita jorgonanpag” nir.
Chaylam Jesusga lapan calpanpa gapachracurcur wanurun.
Chauraga chayüram Diospa wayin ruyichru racta telón cayagsi lachirun ishcayman, janapita uraman.
Chauraga pachrac soldäducunapa mandagninga, Jesuspa naupanchru cayar imanaypa gapachracur wanugtas ricarurga “Cay runaga razonpa Diospa-mayinmi casha” ninmi.
Paytaga ishcay quima warmicunas carupita rircarapäcunagmi. Paycunaga capäcura, Magdala marcapita Mariam, jinaman Jacobopa maman Mariam. Nätan Jacoboga cara Josëpa jinaman Salomëpa shulcanmi.
Chay warmicunaga Galileachru canganpita-pacham Jesusta yanapapäcug, jinaman servipäcug. Chaychrüga capäcuratan mas achca warmicunas, Jesuswan Jerusalenta aywamushacuna.
Jesusta mïchuman enterrangan
Chay junagga cara, jamana junagpag camachracuna tardim. Chauraga nämi pacha chacanayara jamayta galayapäcunanpag.

Chaymi Arimatea marcapita Josëga manchariyanganpita Pilatoman yaycurun “Jesuspa cuerpunta enterramushag” nir, manacug. Chay Josëga cara Jerusalén marcachru mandagcuna castam. Paysi shuyarara Diospa munayninchru cawaytam.
Chaura chaynuy José niruptinga Pilatoga mayacasha niragmi ricacarun. Jinarcurmi shumag musyananpag chay pachrac soldäducunapa mandagninta gayarachin.
Chaura pay chrarurga razonpa nä wanusha cangantam willarun. Chayran Pilatoga “Enterraramuynar” nirura.

Chaura Josëga lïnu ninganpita rurasha tëlatam rantirun. Jinarcurmi Jesuspa cuerpunta jorgarcamurga chaywan wancurun. Chaypitam gagachru uchrcuchingan mïchuman chrurarun. Jinarcurmi jatuncaray rumita cuchrparcachirga chaywan mïchupa puncunta wichrgarun.
Nätan Magdala marcapita Mariawan, Josëpa maman Mariaga mayman chrurapäcungantasi shumagmi rircarapäcura.
